Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep sea-blue amber surface with a golden glow across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale cyan swirls and tiny bubbles flowing through every section, with carved relief of vines and leaves across the surface of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her upper arms held against her sides, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains, her feet shoulder-width apart, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same amber, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Face: her face and ears are NOT amber — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated near-black burgundy lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, deep plum-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM, solid material from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure completely visible. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
